patterns.purpose: State what the festival is, then lead into program discovery and passes.
sections: Typographic hero with festival facts and one city still
patterns.desktop: A twelve-column field uses asymmetric spans, stable still crops, and rules that align real facts.
patterns.mobile: A four-column stack keeps the action visible, previews one next film card, and replaces schedule tables with day lists.
patterns.conversion: Program discovery is primary; pass comparison remains one direct link away.

patterns.purpose: Let visitors compare films before opening one detail record.
patterns.desktop: Each film still occupies three columns and the facts occupy nine, aligned to one repeated baseline.
patterns.mobile: Film records stack image, title, facts, status, and action in that order.
patterns.conversion: A visitor opens one film with its language, access, and screening facts preserved.

patterns.purpose: Filter a dense program and select an eligible screening without losing context.
sections: Grouped screening table or mobile day list
patterns.desktop: The table is the source of truth; day headers and columns share the twelve-column rhythm.
patterns.mobile: A sticky day jump bar precedes readable screening rows and a selected-item action bar.
patterns.conversion: Only available demo screenings advance to the nonfunctional checkout summary.

patterns.purpose: Present every decision fact, then offer a screening selection.
sections: Wide lead still and facts definition list
patterns.desktop: A nine-column still and three-column fact rail establish hierarchy before the selection rows.
patterns.mobile: Title, still, facts, screening, companion still, and related films remain in reading order.
patterns.conversion: The selected screening and its demo status carry into checkout.
